prompt: Create a photorealistic vertical fashion editorial composite at golden hour on a waterfront promenade. Show the same stylish young woman twice in one seamless scene: a very large close-up portrait fills the left foreground from chest up, and a full-body version of her walks in the right midground along the promenade. She has long wavy brown hair, a soft confident smile, and wears black cat-eye sunglasses, pearl drop earrings, a crisp white button-down shirt, black high-waisted wide-leg trousers, white sneakers, and a brown leather shoulder bag. The close-up portrait should be sharply detailed with glossy hair, smooth natural makeup, and warm rim light on the hair; the full-body figure should have one hand in her trouser pocket and appear casually walking toward camera. Set the scene on a paved riverside or seaside promenade with metal railings, vintage black street lamps, sailboats on shimmering water, a distant modern city skyline, exactly four birds silhouetted in the sky, and the low sun near the horizon. Use cinematic sunset lighting with orange clouds, warm reflections on the water and stone pavement, shallow depth of field, realistic lens perspective, high-resolution DSLR quality, elegant travel-fashion magazine mood, no text, no watermark, no extra people.

promptZh: 在黄金时刻的滨水长廊上，创作一张照片级逼真的竖版时尚编辑风格合成图。在同一个无缝场景中展示同一位时尚年轻女性两次：左侧前景为占据大面积画面的胸部以上特写肖像，右侧中景为她沿长廊行走的全身形象。她拥有 棕色长卷发，带着柔和自信的微笑，佩戴黑色猫眼太阳镜、珍珠吊坠耳环，身穿干练的 白色衬衫、黑色高腰阔腿裤、白色运动鞋，并背着一个 棕色皮质单肩包。特写肖像应细节清晰，呈现出光泽感的秀发、自然精致的妆容以及发丝上的暖色轮廓光；全身形象应呈现单手插兜、向镜头方向悠闲行走的姿态。场景设定在铺设好的河畔或海滨长廊，配有金属栏杆、复古黑色路灯、波光粼粼水面上的帆船、远处的现代城市天际线，天空中恰好有四只飞鸟剪影，低垂的太阳靠近地平线。采用电影感的日落光效，呈现橙色云彩、水面与石板路上的暖色倒影，使用浅景深、真实的镜头透视、高分辨率 DSLR 画质，营造优雅的旅行时尚杂志氛围，无文字，无水印，无其他人物。
